title: Learning Analytics
wikitext:
== Overview ==
'''Learning Analytics''' provides data-driven insights into student performance, engagement, and learning outcomes.

== Features ==
* Real-time dashboards
* Student progress tracking
* Predictive analytics
* Engagement metrics
* A/B testing framework

== Use Cases ==
* Instructors: Optimize course content
* Administrators: Track platform performance
* Students: Understand learning progress

== See Also ==
* [[Course Platform]]
* [[Adaptive Learning]]
